lot_details.title: 25/2983 - Snow clearing of municipal properties - lots 1, 2, 5, 7, 16, 17 and 20

texts.value: Larvik municipality shall procure snow clearing services as well as other necessary winter maintenance, such as gritting and hand milling for a number of municipal buildings and properties. All properties/buildings where services shall be provided are located in the areas. A total of seven lots are announced in this contract. These are areas 1, 2, 5, 7, 16, 17 and 20. It is only possible for the contracting authority to award an entire lot and only the routes for which a tender is submitted. If a tenderer would like to compete for multiple routes, tenders must be submitted for all areas. Larvik municipality intends to enter into contracts for 2 + 1 + 1 years. The tentative start of the contracts is 01.10.2025.
